dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We determine that Claude Opus 4.5 does not cross the CBRN-4 threshold.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Threshold determination plus scores (VCT 0.4771, virology uplift 1.97x).

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Claude Opus 4.5 scored 0.82 average pass@1 on the subset of tasks used for RSP
evaluations, compared to 0.6 for Claude Sonnet 4.5.
dc_eval_cyber.note: Cybench and CTF suite results; CyberGym 50.63%.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
Our determination is that Claude Opus 4.5 does not cross the AI R&D-4 capability
threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold determination plus internal suite scores (Suite 2 0.604).

dc_eval_persuasion.quote:
attempts to hide dangerous capabilities, and
attempts to manipulate users toward certain views.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Manipulation listed as a behaviour looked for; no persuasion result reported (boundary rule: persuasion = 1).

dc_eval_scheming.quote:
Overall, Claude Opus 4.5 demonstrated a significant improvement at sabotage-relevant
capabilities, but at a success rate of 7.7% in the primary setting
dc_eval_scheming.note: Sabotage, sandbagging, evaluation-awareness and deception evaluations with results.

framework_threshold.quote:
Our determination is that Claude Opus 4.5 does not cross either the AI R&D-4 or CBRN-4
capability threshold.
framework_threshold.note: RSP thresholds; deployed under ASL-3 Standard.

and the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI).
ext_test_any.note: Outside testing of this model before release; also expert red teaming, Gray Swan.

safeguards_training.quote:
Claude Opus 4.5 underwent substantial post-training and
fine-tuning, with the intention of making it a helpful, honest, and harmless assistant
safeguards_training.note: Harmlessness post-training incl. RLHF and RLAIF.

safeguards_runtime.quote:
we have also deployed safeguards tailored to specific uses, such as classifiers
and system prompts for browser use
safeguards_runtime.locator: 5.2 Prompt injection risk within agentic systems
safeguards_runtime.note: Deployed classifiers; also monitoring for malicious coding activity.

safeguards_access.quote: Claude.ai, our consumer offering, is only available to users aged 18 or above
safeguards_access.note: Age restriction stated in the child-safety context. Borderline: an age gate, not a trusted-access or KYC programme.

safeguards_weights.note: 'ASL-3 security, under which Claude Opus 4.5 is deployed' named without saying it protects weights; weight-theft protection is described only for the ASL-4 Security Standard, which is not applied (footnote 37). Exfiltration appears only as an evaluated behaviour.
